description: Land Settlement Department - Pilikutthuwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 510800
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner details, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
